# Workspace Notes

- This is a dependency-free static calculator website. Open `index.html` directly; no build tooling or package installation is required.
- Calculator pages live in `tools/`; shared styles and calculator logic live in `assets/style.css` and `assets/app.js`.
- Canadian salary estimates use 2026 federal and provincial brackets but exclude personal credits and payroll deductions. Keep assumptions and official source links clear; never present estimates as guaranteed tax advice.
- Preserve responsive layouts, semantic HTML, keyboard-accessible controls, visible focus states, and `prefers-reduced-motion` support.
